messages:
alice.devex: heads-up — Acme escalation: 401s started after a client update, plus big token usage spike from retries. dumping thread here. :rotating_light:

carol.support: Customer says it started ~2026-02-18 15:12 UTC. Their app started failing auth and then retried aggressively. Quick log we got from them:

carol.support: ```
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-CUST\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-std","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
HTTP/2 401
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: req_acme_01
{
  "error": {"message":"invalid auth header: expected X-Api-Key"}
}
```

carol.support: They said the spike shows ~30k extra tokens across 2 hours. Billing team flagged it.

ben.eng: looking — I saw a related CI regen job last week that changed the security scheme name in the OpenAPI spec. gist: securitySchemes: api_key: type: apiKey name: X-Api-Key in spec v1.2.0. Old runtime accepted Authorization Bearer.

ben.eng: quick summary: some SDKs were regenerated after the spec change and now send X-Api-Key; other clients and our gateway still expect Authorization. Mismatch => 401s. Clients retry and cause token billing spike.

dave.ml: which SDK versions?

ben.eng: python-client@0.10.0 (regen after spec change) sets header \"X-Api-Key\", python-client@0.9.1 still uses Authorization. TS-go builds vary. Customer was on a mixed fleet (some pods updated).

carol.support: customer used our hosted gateway (no custom header mapping). they upgraded one service to 0.10.0 and left others on 0.9.x, which produced the mix of good/bad requests and the retry storms.

alice.devex: can we repro quickly? we need repro steps to show the billing/retry path and a short mitigation for the customer.

ben.eng: yes. repro steps (quick):
1) run an old runtime image that only accepts Authorization.
2) call with X-Api-Key header -> 401.
3) simulate client retry loop (exponential backoff with max attempts 5) to reproduce token count.

ben.eng: example curl for repro:```
curl -i https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"X-Api-Key: sk-TEST\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-std","prompt":"hello"}'
```

eve.ci: action items I propose:
- Short-term (hotfix): patch gateway to accept both Authorization and X-Api-Key for 72 hours. owner: @ben.eng.
- Mid-term: regenerate all SDKs from canonical spec v1.2.0 and publish 0.10.x -> owner: @eve.ci and @dave.ml, target: 2026-02-20 EOD.
- CI: add a drift check that validates securitySchemes.name in OpenAPI vs a whitelist of runtime-accepted headers. fail CI if mismatch. owner: @eve.ci, target: next week.
- Changelog: add explicit breaking note about header rename and compatibility guidance. owner: @alice.devex.

carol.support: customer-facing mitigation: ask Acme to pin SDK to 0.9.1 or upgrade all services to 0.10.0, and we'll open a temporary billing credit while we patch gateway. They accepted the temporary credit if we can provide fix ETA.

dave.ml: I'll start regen job. small compatibility trick: we can add a header shim in SDKs that sends both headers for one release (Authorization + X-Api-Key) so rolling fleets don't get 401s. That reduces risk.

ben.eng: agreed. shim in SDKs + gateway accepting both headers should buy time. We should avoid long-term double-header behaviour though — add telemetry to measure how many requests rely on shim.

alice.devex: can we add an automated smoke test in deploy pipeline that runs a single request with both headers and fails if gateway rejects both?

eve.ci: yes. I'll add a smoke test in the cross-sdk regen CI: after regen, run clients to call staging endpoint and assert 200 with either header.

infra-bot: deploy plan scheduled: gateway-compat-patch -> canary rollout 2026-02-19 02:00 UTC, owner: ben.eng.

carol.support: I've told Acme we'll have temporary credit and ETA 2026-02-20 for full SDKs + compat patch. They've paused mass deploys until that window.

alice.devex: thanks team. owners recap: ben to patch gateway + canary, eve + dave regen + publish SDKs with shim, alice to add changelog and comms, eve to add CI drift check. Follow up tomorrow morning in this thread. :eyes:

ben.eng: I'll open PRs for gateway patch + regen checklist now.

dave.ml: starting regen job (kicking off openapi->clients). will post artifacts.

alice.devex: closing loop: please update thread with PR links and publish notes once done.
